description: Decline a request. Needs `bookings:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

expected_updated_at.description: The booking's `updated_at` as you read it: a booking that changed since is refused (precondition_failed). Leave it out to have the first call read the booking and pin it.

name: decline_request
title: Decline a request
